acceptance_signals: A matching human-admitted task exists before repository writes for the evidence-detail UI refinement.
A create-only task-start scope baseline is captured before page edits.

The fluorescent result background and bright lime accents are removed from the artifact pages and replaced with a restrained palette consistent with the existing paper, ink, muted-purple, border, and typography system.
Both language pages visibly distinguish observed replay facts, editorially derived interview explanation, and unknown or unproven outcomes.

Every architecture step and result metric provides a concrete detail panel on mouse hover and keyboard focus, with an accessible focus target, a short definition, the relevant observed relationship, and a repository-relative evidence source or evidence-boundary statement.
The result detail explains that 189 regular members equal 183 managed byte matches plus six generated metadata members, with zero managed mismatch and zero unexpected unmanaged members.

Both pages retain one controller, one dry, one actual, zero retry, 186 of 186 input matches, the exact wheel SHA-256 sha256:64f48914b60ae9a7638275f1a9f3b3727bc15b7226c76b37babe08475bae685a, the exact evidence SHA-256 ffc06da3060b459ff39c8602365126a860e8228dd6320c8c88f69cbc8c6b8715, and final zero short roots.
Hover disclosures also work through keyboard focus, respect reduced motion, avoid JavaScript and inline styles or scripts, and remain readable at narrow widths.

Focused tests protect the muted palette, evidence taxonomy, hover and focus behavior, concrete metric relationships, bilingual equivalence, critical evidence facts, UTF-8 Chinese, CSP, and local-only assets.
Local browser QA verifies both visual hierarchy and at least one metric disclosure by hover and focus on the Chinese page, plus reciprocal English navigation.

The immutable replay evidence remains byte-identical with SHA-256 ffc06da3060b459ff39c8602365126a860e8228dd6320c8c88f69cbc8c6b8715, and excluded implementation, contract, configuration, evidence, shared assets, prior-log, README, and Markdown paths remain unchanged.
User-documentation tests, task governance, repository governance, captured scope, immutable evidence hash, task JSON, and git diff --check pass.
No image generation, replay, build action, dependency installation, network access, Git mutation, commit, push, hosting, publication, release, deployment, or external-Agent action occurs.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-0c02d43eb2ac41d59bccf8453b71c80b and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Refine the existing English and Simplified Chinese artifact replay presentation pages in response to the human's screenshot review. Replace the fluorescent result treatment with a restrained, consistent paper, ink, muted-purple, and soft-sage palette. Make the content concrete by labeling observed run facts, editorially derived explanation, and unknown outcomes. Add keyboard-accessible hover and focus detail panels to the architecture steps and every result metric so a presenter can reveal the definition, exact observed fact, relationship to adjacent numbers, and repository evidence source without JavaScript. Preserve the bilingual semantic equivalence, exact evidence identities, local-only operation, and existing release and authority boundaries. Add focused tests, update STATUS.md and the 2026-08-27 log, and perform local browser visual and interaction QA without hosting or publication.

items: Hover-only content would exclude keyboard and touch users; focus disclosure and narrow-screen behavior must be included.
Explanatory copy can accidentally blur observed facts and editorial framing unless the evidence taxonomy is explicit.
Detail panels can overlap or clip at viewport edges and require browser QA.
A visual refinement must not edit or regenerate receipt-validated evidence.
Hosting and publication remain separate human-controlled actions.
Reviewed assumption: The screenshot accurately represents the current page and the fluorescent result panel is the primary visual inconsistency.
Reviewed assumption: Concrete hover and focus disclosures are more useful than adding a new modal or JavaScript interaction.
Reviewed assumption: Repository evidence and the dated closeout remain the authoritative source for all observed claims.
Reviewed assumption: A muted soft-sage success accent can distinguish PASS without competing with the established purple brand accent.
Reviewed unknown: The presenter's preferred information density after using the new disclosures in a real interview.
Reviewed unknown: Exact rendering in browsers other than the locally tested browser.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the refined presentation improves interview outcomes.
